info.name: Notes REST API
info.description:
Assignment 6 — RESTful notes API (Express + MongoDB + bcrypt + JWT).

Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection → Run, or `npm run test:api`). Signup stores the tokens and the created note id in collection variables, so later requests reuse them.

Change `baseUrl` in the collection variables if the server is not on http://localhost:3000.
